description: This file defines the CandidateDao class within a Human Resource Management system, which provides data access methods for candidate-related entities such as candidates, job vacancies, interviews, and candidate history. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying candidates and related data, utilizing an ORM framework.

classes.name: CandidateDao
classes.description: Data Access Object providing methods for managing candidates, candidacies, interviews, and related entities in a recruitment system.

methods.name: getCandidatesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of candidates based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCandidateById
methods.description: Returns a candidate entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveCandidate
methods.description: Persists a candidate entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteCandidates
methods.description: Deletes multiple candidates by their IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Fetches CandidateVacancy for a given candidate ID.

methods.name: saveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Saves a CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: saveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Saves a record of candidate history.

methods.name: getInterviewCountByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Counts interviews for a specific candidate and vacancy.

methods.name: saveCandidateInterview
methods.description: Saves an interview record.

methods.name: getCandidateIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all candidate IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all interview IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateIdListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewById
methods.description: Fetches an interview entity by its ID.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecords
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history records based on search filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns count of candidate history records matching filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordByCandidateIdAndHistoryId
methods.description: Fetches a candidate history record by candidate and history IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewByCandidateIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves an interview by candidate and interview IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdsByCandidateId
methods.description: Returns list of interview IDs for a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdList
methods.description: Returns list of all candidate history IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Returns candidate history IDs for a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns candidate history IDs for a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns vacancy IDs where a specific employee is an interviewer.

methods.name: getCurrentVacancyIdByCandidateId
methods.description: Gets the current vacancy ID for a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history records for candidate and vacancy.
